description: Agenticaso scans public websites for signals that help AI agents find, understand, recommend, and transact with a brand. It returns an AI-agent readiness score across four pillars—Found, Understood, Recommended, and Bought—along with evidence-based priority fixes. No account is required to scan a public website.

defaultPrompt: Scan https://example.com for AI-agent readiness and explain the four pillar scores.
Audit https://www.shopify.com and list the highest-priority improvements for AI visibility and recommendation.
Scan https://www.allbirds.com and summarize its strongest and weakest AI-agent readiness signals.
